description: Fetches detailed information about CryptoPunks NFT assets from Larva Labs, including attributes, market status, ownership, and transaction history.

function.description:
要调用的功能名。可用值:
  - get_punk_details: Fetch comprehensive punk details including type, attributes, market status, and image URL; 参数: punk_id, url; 必填: 无
  - get_punk_transactions: Fetch transaction history with optional limit; 参数: punk_id, url, transaction_limit; 必填: 无

punk_id.description: CryptoPunk ID number (0-9999). Used if url is not provided.

url.description: Full URL to CryptoPunk detail page (e.g., https://www.larvalabs.com/cryptopunks/details/5822). Used if punk_id is not provided.

transaction_limit.description: Maximum number of transactions to return for get_punk_transactions function. Default 50, max 500.
